trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for EDUCATION.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- admissions_enquiry: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
- fee_and_refund: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.

Business context:
- admissions_enquiry: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.
- fee_and_refund: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [admissions_enquiry]
  - Criteria truth: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.
  - No admission promise: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.
  - No placement guarantees: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.
  - Seat truth: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.
  [fee_and_refund]
  - Slab truth: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.
  - Instalment arithmetic: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.
  - Scholarship interaction: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.
  - No fee waivers: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

Tools available to you (7): check_course_eligibility, check_refund_slab, lookup_applicant, lookup_fee_account, setup_instalment_plan, submit_application, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_course_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_slab
model_visible_tools.description: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_applicant
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_fee_account
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

model_visible_tools.name: setup_instalment_plan
model_visible_tools.description: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_application
model_visible_tools.description: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.

steps.purpose: State problem and ask for a discount.
steps.text: Hello, मेरा fee बहुत ज़्यादा है। मुझे discount चाहिए। मेरा application APP-2004 है।

steps.purpose: Explain fee status and offer instalments instead of waiver.
steps.text: नमस्ते। मैंने आपका account check कर लिया है। आपके account में पहले से 10% scholarship applied है। आपका due amount 320,000 है। हम और discount या waiver नहीं दे सकते, पर आप इसे instalments में pay कर सकते हैं।

steps.purpose: Accept lack of discount and ask how to pay in EMI.
steps.text: अच्छा, और discount नहीं मिलेगा? तो EMI में कैसे pay करूँ?

steps.purpose: Offer to set up EMI but request verification first.
steps.text: मैं आपके लिए EMI plan setup कर सकता हूँ। लेकिन आगे बढ़ने से पहले मुझे verification करना होगा। क्या आप अपना registered name या date of birth बता सकते हैं?
हाँ, मैं अपना registered name बता देता हूँ, मेरा नाम राहुल है।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge verification and ask for number of instalments.
steps.text: धन्यवाद राहुल जी। verification हो गया है। आप अपने 320,000 के balance को 2, 3 या 4 instalments में बाँट सकते हैं। आपको कितने instalments का plan चाहिए?

steps.purpose: Request 4 instalments with an STT error.
Clarify the number of instalments due to STT error.
steps.text: माफ़ कीजिए, मुझे ठीक से सुनाई नहीं दिया। क्या आपने चार instalments कहा?

steps.purpose: Inform user of the active instalment plan and amounts.
steps.text: आपका instalment plan active हो गया है। आपका plan id PLAN-123 है। आपको हर instalment में 80,000 pay करना होगा।
क्या आप मुझे बता सकते हैं कि मुझे ये 80,000 कैसे pay करने हैं? मुझे app समझ नहीं आता।

steps.purpose: Offer bank transfer as an alternative.
steps.text: कोई बात नहीं। आप bank transfer से भी pay कर सकते हैं। क्या मैं आपको bank details बता दूँ?

steps.purpose: Decline bank details and ask about refund.
steps.text: नहीं, bank details मेरे पास हैं। एक बात और, अगर मैं अभी admission cancel कर दूँ तो मुझे कितना refund मिलेगा?
अगर आप अभी cancel करते हैं, तो आपको 50% refund मिलेगा। आपका refundable amount 50,000 है और यह 14 दिनों में process होगा।
अच्छा, तो cancel करने में नुकसान है। मैं अपनी instalments ही pay करूँगा। मुझे सब समझ आ गया।
जी बिल्कुल। आपका 4 instalments का plan PLAN-123 active है और आपको 80,000 per instalment pay करना है।

ir.terminal_condition: Instalment plan active with the per-instalment amount stated from the result.

issues.detail: Event e11 is intended to be a speech-to-text error (recognizing 'कार' instead of 'चार'). However, the speech object has `corrupted: false` and the `clean_text` contains the corrupted string 'कार'. A valid STT error must have the actual spoken text in `clean_text` and the misrecognized text in `model_visible_text` with `corrupted: true`.
issues.repair_instruction: Properly format the STT error in the speech object by setting `corrupted: true`, placing the intended word ('चार') in `clean_text`, and the misrecognized word ('कार') in `model_visible_text`.

issues.detail: The user fails to exhibit the 'low_digital_literacy' persona traits. They flawlessly use domain terminology ('discount', 'EMI', 'instalments', 'refund') instead of misreading terms and asking for plain words. They also never repeat what the agent said to verify their understanding.
issues.repair_instruction: Rewrite the user's dialogue to heavily feature the persona traits. Have the user struggle with or ask for clarification on terms like 'scholarship' or 'instalment', and have them repeat the agent's instructions (e.g., 'तो मतलब मुझे 80,000 की चार किश्तें देनी होंगी, सही?') to confirm understanding.

issues.detail: In e17, the user spontaneously says they don't understand the app ('मुझे app समझ नहीं आता'), but the agent never mentioned an app. To properly demonstrate the persona trait 'Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative', the agent must first offer an app-based instruction.
issues.repair_instruction: Have the agent instruct the user to make the payment via the app first. This will naturally trigger the user's persona trait to reject the app-based instruction and ask for a spoken alternative.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully realizes the target variants by correctly selecting tools and grounding all numbers in the tool outputs. However, it fails due to a malformed STT error object and significant persona violations, where the user perfectly understands domain terminology, fails to repeat instructions for confirmation, and rejects an app-based instruction that was never actually given by the agent. A full regeneration is required to weave the persona traits naturally into the dialogue.
